description: Protein properties: molecular weight, isoelectric point, GRAVY, extinction coefficient and composition.

a280.description: A measured absorbance at 280 nm. When given, the response adds `concentration` in mg/mL and µM for both extinction coefficients.

chargeStep.description: pH step along the net-charge titration curve, which always spans pH 0-14. Between 0.001 and 14.

dilution.description: How many-fold the sample was diluted before the A280 was read.

pathLengthCm.description: Path length of the A280 reading in cm (a NanoDrop already reports values normalised to 1 cm).

sequence.description: Protein sequence (one-letter amino-acid codes; non-AA characters ignored).

name: protein_properties
title: Protein Properties
